## 📖 Overview

**Quimail PRO** is a cutting-edge, AI-powered email ID generator that creates professional, memorable email addresses with an intelligent scoring system and realistic inbox preview. Built with a stunning cyberpunk glassmorphism UI, it's perfect for professionals, developers, and creatives.

### Why Quimail PRO?

- 🎯 **Smart Generation** - AI-powered pattern matching with 20+ variations
- 📊 **Quality Scoring** - Each email gets a 0-100% professional score
- 👁️ **Live Preview** - Realistic inbox-style email preview
- 🎨 **Beautiful UI** - Cyberpunk glassmorphism design
- 🚀 **Zero Dependencies** - Runs on pure Python + Tkinter

---

## ✨ Features

### Core Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| 🧠 **Smart Engine** | Advanced pattern matching with 20+ username variations |
| 📊 **Quality Score** | Intelligent scoring based on length, readability & domain popularity |
| 🎯 **4 Style Modes** | Professional, Creative, Tech, Tech-Hustle |
| 👁️ **Email Preview** | Realistic inbox view with proper formatting |
| 📋 **One-Click Copy** | Copy emails instantly to clipboard |
| 💾 **Save Function** | Export emails to text file |
| 🌐 **Domain Database** | Premium domains with popularity ratings |

## 🚀 Installation

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.7 or higher
- Tkinter (included with Python)

### Quick Start

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/Rg100152/Quimail.git

# Navigate to directory
cd Quimail

# Run the application
python quimail_pro.py
```

Android (Pydroid 3)

1. Install Pydroid 3 from Play Store
2. Copy quimail_pro.py to your device
3. Open with Pydroid 3
4. Press ▶️ Run

No pip install required! 🎉

---

💻 Usage

Basic Usage

1. Enter Your Details
   ```
   First Name: John
   Last Name: Doe
   Profession: Developer (optional)
   Lucky Number: 7 (optional)
   ```
2. Select Email Style
   · 👔 Professional - Formal business emails
   · 🎨 Creative - Artistic & unique
   · 💻 Tech - Developer focused
   · 🚀 Tech-Hustle - Modern edge
3. Generate & Select
   · Click GENERATE EMAILS
   · Browse generated emails
   · Click to preview in inbox view
4. Copy or Save
   · 📋 Copy - Copies to clipboard
   · ⭐ Save - Saves to file
   · 🔄 Refresh - Regenerate

Quality Score Guide

Score Rating Description
90-100 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent - Short, clean, premium domain
80-89 ⭐⭐⭐⭐ Very Good - Professional & readable
60-79 ⭐⭐⭐ Good - Functional & acceptable
Below 60 ⭐⭐ Basic - Works but could be better

🏗️ Architecture

```
Quimail/
├── quimail_pro.py          # Main application file
├── README.md               # Documentation
├── LICENSE                 # MIT License
└── saved_emails.txt        # Saved emails (auto-created)
```

Class Structure

```python
QuimailPro (Main Application)
├── AdvancedEmailEngine (Generation Logic)
│   ├── generate_emails()
│   ├── calculate_email_score()
│   └── generate_username_variations()
│
├── EmailPreviewCard (Preview Component)
│   ├── create_preview()
│   └── show_inbox_view()
│
└── UI Components
    ├── build_header()
    ├── build_input_section()
    ├── build_category_section()
    └── build_results_section()
```

🔧 Technical Details

Generation Algorithm

```python
Score = (Length_Score × 30) + (Complexity_Score × 20) 
        + (Readability_Score × 15) + (Domain_Popularity / 3)
```

Pattern Examples

Style Pattern Example
Professional {first}.{last} john.doe@gmail.com
Creative iam{first} iamjohn@yahoo.com
Tech dev.{first} dev.john@protonmail.com
Tech-Hustle neo.{first} neo.john@duck.com
